text:
deploy-bot: Starting migration job: MIG-2026-07-18-09 on service `user_profiles`
```
> migrate --id=MIG-2026-07-18-09 --plan=partitioned-backfill --batch_size=1000 --pin-version=v2.4.1
```
Expect ~2.1M rows over ~3 hours, will auto-throttle on lock contention. Notifying #eng-releases. :rocket:

alice: Thanks — I'm watching. Ben and Carol oncall for schema and backfill respectively. Can we keep canary on 10% traffic to start?

ben: yep, canary 10%. I'll pin the service image to `v2.4.1` for the first 30m.

carol: noted. I pushed a preflight that checks row counts and open txs every 60s. If lock wait > 2000ms for 3 samples, deploy-bot will cut batch_size in half.

deploy-bot: MIG-2026-07-18-09 status: RUNNING (canary=10%). First partition started (p0).

ben: seeing increased p95 DB lock wait on p0 (approx 750ms -> 2200ms). Dropping traffic to canary 5% and pinning to read-only mirroring for non-critical reads.

carol: switching backfill strategy — will switch to async partitioned scan for hot partitions and set batch limiter to 500. Doing that now.

deploy-bot: AUTO-THROTTLE triggered for MIG-2026-07-18-09: batch_size=1000 -> 500 due to lock_wait > 2000ms (3 samples).

alice: Good. If lock wait doesn't drop in 2 more samples we should hit the escape hatch and pause the migration. Have rollback steps ready?

dboncall: I'm oncall. Rollback runbook: 1) pause migration via `deploy-bot pause MIG-2026-07-18-09` 2) verify canary traffic pinned to `v2.4.1` 3) if errors > threshold, use `deploy-bot rollback service=user-profiles to v2.4.0` 4) DB: run `pg_cancel_backend` for stuck sessions then follow https://redwood.internal/runbooks/db-migration-escape-hatch. I can take handoff.

ben: I can prepare the service rollback artifact but prefer to avoid full rollback if we can continue in staged backfill. Carol, status on lock waits?

carol: lock waits dipped to ~900ms after batch halved, but hot partition p3 still spikes occasionally. I recommend we pause p3 and continue other partitions. I will requeue p3 with smaller windowed scans and a rate limiter: `--partition=p3 --window=15m --batch=200`.

alice: Agreed. Let's pause p3 and keep the rest moving. dboncall, can you run the pause for p3 partitions in the deploy job?

dboncall: On it. Running: `deploy-bot pause MIG-2026-07-18-09 --partitions=p3`

deploy-bot: Command accepted. Paused partitions: p3. Remaining partitions continuing. Canary remains 5%.

alice: Carol, add a short note to the release notes about p3 being delayed and the mitigation plan so support doesn't get surprise tickets. Also add the specific `pg_stat_activity` query used for monitoring.

carol: Done. Snippet added to release notes: ```sql
SELECT pid, state, wait_event_type, wait_event, query_start, query FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state <> 'idle' ORDER BY query_start DESC LIMIT 50;
```

ben: Quick heads up — I deployed a small runtime guard that rejects writes to the feature flag controlling partition creation to avoid schema drift during the backfill.

alice: Good. If we need to fully abort: threshold is >=3 partitions paused for >30m OR global lock_wait sustained >2000ms for >10m. Then we run rollback plan.

deploy-bot: Monitoring. Next auto-check in 60s.

carol: After p3 pause, overall lock waits trending down (p95 ~ 650ms). Will start p3 windowed job in 10m with `--batch=200`.

dboncall: Confirmed. I ran health checks post-pause: replicas aligned, no long-running txs. All looks safe to continue.

alice: OK team — we keep staged rollout. Ben keep image pinned for 1h from now. Carol resume p3 with windowed scans in 10m. dboncall remain on standby for 1h. If anything degrades, pause everything and escalate to SRE lead.

deploy-bot: MIG-2026-07-18-09 update: STAGED_CONTINUE. batch_size applied=500, partitions paused=[p3], canary=5%. Next auto-sample at +60s.

alice: TL;DR for release notes: "Partitioned backfill started; automatic throttle triggered due to transient lock contention; one hot partition (p3) paused and will be backfilled using smaller windowed batches to avoid replica lag. No rollback required."

carol: I'll post a short postmortem if p3 needs further work, but for now marking remediation as temporary rate-limiter and partition windowing.

ben: I'll unpin the image once we've been green for 30m. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: MIG-2026-07-18-09 last_event=STAGED_CONTINUE at 2209876599
